text:
marco: Quick sync  Ottawa-Borealis region is in partner gating with CloudVendor + SiliconCo + NimbleSI. Need to lock SKU entitlements, quotas, KMS/HSM artifacts, and SI test creds this week. Who can pick up each lane?

elaine: I'll program-manage and publish a rolling checklist. Can someone drop expected committed capacity numbers so marketplace requests look realistic?

jia: Infra recs: reserved baseline 8 GPUs, steady state 24 GPUs, promo/peak 48 GPUs. Request packet: 48 A100-equivalents, 400 vCPUs, 1TB NVMe scratch. Autoscale policy: min=8, target=24, max=48, cooldown=120s. Enable prefix/KV cache for model pools.

sam: Filed quota ticket CV-QT-21190 (https://partner.cloud/vendor/quotas/CV-QT-21190). Included usage profile + concurrency matrix. CloudVendor replied: "acknowledged, 3 business days SLAs."

marketplace-bot: CV-QT-21190 created by sam  status=open  assignee=cloud-quotas@redwood  link=https://partner.cloud/vendor/quotas/CV-QT-21190

marco: Marketplace entitlements: CloudVendor requires SKU mapping, pricing tier, and sample contract terms. I need SKU mapping by EOD tomorrow to request entitlements. Also SiliconCo will only accept marketplace images with customer-managed keys present and signed HSM attestations.

ashley: I'll handle entitlement request form + SKU mapping. Quick Q: do we publish "Dedicated - Standard" and "Dedicated - Promo" SKUs or use a single dynamic SKU with tiers? Recommendation: two SKUs to keep billing and quotas simple.

marco: Two SKUs sounds right. Ashley please coordinate with finance for pricing tiers and add a short description for the marketplace listing.

katie: Legal notes: need logo usage agreement and a co-marketing MSA addendum before any joint public announcement. I'll draft the addendum template and request partner review. PR/marketing window should be T+7 business days after quotas and KMS attestation are complete.

jia: KMS/HSM flow: SiliconCo will provide HSM signing cert + key-policy doc. We must provide their onboarding team a service account with kms.viewer and artifact.upload roles. Also request HSM cert chain and nonce signing test vectors.

sam: I've requested SiliconCo HSM certs: Ticket SC-HSM-604 (status: pending). Will follow up in 24h and paste artifacts to shared secure bucket once received.

marco: SI integration: NimbleSI needs API creds for automated smoke tests and a short test dataset. @jia can we provide a time-limited service account token scoped to: inference.invoke, metrics.read? We should also create a test harness route.

jia: Yes. I'll spin a temporary service account token with 72h validity and limit to test CIDR for NimbleSI. Will post token delivery steps in the secure channel. Smoke test plan: 50 concurrent sessions, 2k tokens/session for 30m. Pass criteria: median latency < 220ms, 99th < 900ms, <=1% error.

ashley: Ops checklist draft in shared drive: https://redwood.internal/partnerships/ottawa-borealis/ops-checklist (working). Key items: SKU mapping, quota ticket, HSM certs, SI creds, legal MSA, marketplace screenshots, launch blog draft.

marco: Can we set a soft launch/canary for internal customers T+3 days after quota approval, public marketplace listing T+7 after KMS certs + legal signoff? That gives time for a 48h canary & rollback window.

katie: Sounds good. I'll block PR review slots for T+5 so we have time to iterate after canary. Also need final partner logo PNGs (SVG preferred) and proof of trademark approval.

sam: If CV-QT-21190 is not approved within 48h I'll escalate to our CloudVendor partner manager and copy AM. I'll also attach an expanded throughput appendix that maps tokens/min to required GPUs.

marketplace-bot: CV-QT-21190 status update: acknowledged -> in-review (est. 72h).

elaine: Owners: sam (quotas & escalations), jia (infra config, tokens, kv cache & smoke tests), ashley (marketplace SKU mapping & ops checklist), marco (partner comms & entitlement forms), katie (legal & PR). I'll circulate a timeline by EOD and schedule a 30m checkpoint tomorrow at 10:30 PT. :calendar:

marco: I'll also draft the marketplace blurb and attach sample screenshots by EOD.

katie: I'll prepare the MSA addendum template and ask legal to pre-clear common clauses today.

elaine: Thanks all. Next steps: Sam update ticket CV-QT-21190 when CloudVendor confirms quotas, Jia post HSM onboarding steps when SiliconCo artifacts arrive, Ashley file entitlement request with marketplace form once SKU mapping is final. We'll reconvene on the 10:30 checkpoint.
